killedBy: createStores hands the versus setup store this save's progress, so a stored board it has not unlocked reads back as Random (issue #983)
why: The browser wiring of the stored-setup place: `createStores` builds the setup store without the progress read, so the store-level gate exists and is tested but is never handed the real progress. Every store-level case injects its own unlock, so only a case that goes through `createStores` can see this. Proved before its tests existed: SURVIVES at 0 of 49 in scope on the gate's own commit, then KILLED by 1 of 50, measured.
